summary: Allow existing nodes to restore host-appropriate steady-state Bitcoin tuning
details: set-bitcoin-profile now accepts auto and persists the concrete balanced-32g or performance-64g profile selected from physical host memory.
Command help describes every profile's memory, memory-plus-swap, dbcache, host requirement, and intended lifecycle; automatic selection never enables the temporary ibd-64g profile.
The profile argument remains mandatory so omitting it cannot silently mutate an existing node configuration.
